segments.name: Autonomous Systems ("AxS")
segments.description: Provides uncrewed aircraft, loitering munitions, counter-UAS, electronic warfare, maritime and ground systems for defense customers and warfighters.
segments.evidence: Effective May 1, 2025 in connection with our acquisition of BlueHalo Financing Topco, LLC ("BlueHalo"), we operate our business in two reportable segments: (1) Autonomous Systems ("AxS") and (2) Space, Cyber and Directed Energy ("SCDE").

segments.name: Space, Cyber and Directed Energy ("SCDE")
segments.description: Provides space technology, directed energy laser systems, and cyber and mission solutions for U.S. defense, intelligence, and national security customers.
segments.evidence: Our Cyber and Mission Solutions Group provides advanced cyber, intel, defense operations, and basic/applied R&D solutions that deliver mission-critical expertise and prototype development for U.S. defense, intelligence community, and national security customers.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily defense and national security agencies, pay the company for its products and services, and some customers require substantial financing to fund purchases.
revenueModel.evidence: Some of our customers may require substantial financing in order to fund their operations and make purchases from us.
